title: How TradesStation Works | Free, No-Obligation Quotes
description: How TradesStation helps you find local builders and tradespeople: describe your job, compare quotes and hire the right person. Free, with no obligation.
cardText: Describe your job, compare quotes, hire with confidence
intro: TradesStation is a free guide and introduction service for homeowners. We help you understand your job, then point you to trusted quote platforms so you can hear from local tradespeople.

items.title: Find your trade
items.text: Pick the trade you need and read what to check before you hire.

items.title: Describe your job
items.text: Request quotes through our partner platforms with one simple description.

items.title: Compare and hire
items.text: Compare tradespeople, check them, and agree the job directly.

sections.html: Yes. Using TradesStation and requesting quotes through our partners is free for homeowners, with no obligation to hire.

Some links on TradesStation are referral links. When we introduce you to a partner platform, that partner may pay us a fee. This never changes the price you pay a tradesperson. Read more about how we make money.

Tradespeople are independent businesses listed with our partner platforms. TradesStation does not employ, endorse or vet individual tradespeople, so always make your own checks. Our hiring guide explains how.

You will get more useful replies if you know the basics: what you want done, your rough timescale, whether you own the property, and whether you have drawings or planning permission. For larger jobs, read our guide to planning an extension and choosing a builder first.

sections.h2: What to check after you are introduced
sections.html: TradesStation does not employ, vet or guarantee tradespeople. Ask for proof of any registration that applies to the trade, such as Gas Safe for gas work, and ask about insurance and how they handle Building Regulations. Get quotes in writing and read the contract; see what to include in a builder contract.

ctaTitle: What job do you need doing?

faqs.q: Do I have to accept a quote?
faqs.a: No. Requesting quotes is free and carries no obligation, so you can compare several and decide whether to go ahead.

faqs.q: Can you recommend a specific builder?
faqs.a: We introduce you to quote services and explain what to check, but we do not endorse or guarantee any individual tradesperson. Always do your own checks before hiring.
